Coram:

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE YOGESH KHANNA  ORDER % 21.02.2023 1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
3. Petitioner seeks interim bail for 15 days on the ground of marriage of cousin sister on 22.02.2023.
I have heard the arguments.
The allegations against petitioner are under Section 376 IPC.

There are two other brothers of the petitioner to perform the marriage ceremony, hence I am not inclined to release the petitioner on interim bail, though the petitioner be taken in custody at the marriage venue i.e. Vishwakarma Palace, Shani Bazar Road, Theke KE Samne, Budh Vihar, Phase-II,
Delhi-110086 on 22.02.2023 and shall be allowed to stay there from 07.00PM to 11.00PM and then be brought back to Jail.
To and fro time be excluded from the visit.
The staff accompanying the petitioner will be in plain clothes.
The Jail Superintendent is directed to make arrangement for said visit.
4. In view of above the petition stands disposed of.
Pending application, if any, also stands disposed of.
